nodes.title: Snap new shapes to existing objects
nodes.summary: Allow the user to snap a newly added shape to an existing object on the canvas. This applies once a shape has been placed and added to the component tree as a nested child.
nodes.detail: {"planState":"tasks_created"}

nodes.title: Cursor-following shape preview
nodes.summary: After the user clicks another shape in the shape selector, a representation of the selected shape follows the cursor around the canvas.
nodes.detail: {"planState":"tasks_created"}

nodes.title: Highlight hovered snap side
nodes.summary: When the cursor passes over an existing object, highlight the side of that object being hovered so the user can see where the new shape will snap.

nodes.title: Click to snap to selected side
nodes.summary: A second click snaps the new shape to the highlighted side of the existing object.

nodes.title: Circle angular snap points
nodes.summary: For circles, snapping occurs at fixed angles of 0, 45, 90, 135, 180 and 325 degrees, wrapping back to 0/360.
